description: How the LongMemEval oracle runs were produced, end to end. Every value here is what the committed manifests record; the commands reproduce the N = 30 headline pair (lme-oracle-n30-a and -b) and, with --per-type 15, the N = 15 pair.

commits.measured_note: lme-oracle-a, lme-oracle-b and lme-oracle-n30-a ran at 9883405; lme-oracle-n30-b at 5a9a363, which adds only the offline bench/longmemeval/diagnose.py.

engine.engine_code_note: git diff aa7daa2 -- engraphy/ is empty at both commits: the engine is the one both LoCoMo held-out runs measured. The branch adds harness work only: the LongMemEval loader with date-ordered sessions, the question date shown to the reader, concurrent haystack ingest, and the official conventions.

dataset.name: LongMemEval, oracle setting (longmemeval_oracle.json)
dataset.citation: Wu et al., LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory, ICLR 2025, arXiv 2410.10813

questions.sampler: bench.longmemeval.sample, a statement-for-statement reproduction of sample_questions_stratified from mem0ai/memory-benchmarks@4b61c5d31b9c668a12b4f5e78064248a02c82d2b

official_conventions.vendored: bench/prompts/longmemeval/*.upstream* in the engine checkout, pinned by sha256

commands: git clone https://github.com/EngraphyLabs/engraphy.git && cd engraphy && git checkout 9883405554b556828a19216f639ccd97972d9173
mkdir -p datasets/longmemeval && curl -L -o datasets/longmemeval/longmemeval_oracle.json <dataset.url>   # then check the sha256

python -m bench.core.run --benchmark longmemeval --dataset datasets/longmemeval/longmemeval_oracle.json --haystacks $IDS --arm llm_wide-conversational:search_only:k=25 --judge claude --reader-stance grounded --reader-contract verify --phases ingest,answer,judge,calibrate,report --ingest-concurrency 6 --concurrency 6 --judge-concurrency 8 --calibration-sample 40 --run-id lme-oracle-n30-a
# repeat the last three with --run-id lme-oracle-n30-b for the second run
requirements: As for LoCoMo (README, Reproduce): Docker with a pgvector Postgres at the engine's schema, Python 3.12 or later, and the Claude Code CLI signed in. Each run draws on the signed-in account's usage.
known_limits: On Windows, an extraction window longer than about 32 KB fails at launch on the CLI route and is recorded as empty; 13 of the 500 oracle questions are affected. Diagnosis section 5.
On the CLI route the model can see the signed-in account's identity; scripts/redact_longmemeval.py removes it from committed copies.
